annotations.title: Screen up to 25 names against the LEIE

description: Screens up to 25 person or business names in one call against the same LEIE mirror as screen_exclusion and returns only the best possible match per name (or no match at the threshold) in compact form, with a summary count. When a state, npi or dob filter leaves out every record at or above the threshold, the result for that entry is no_match_after_filters and it shows the best record the filter left out. Each entry can be a name string or an object with name and optional state, npi and dob (YYYY-MM-DD).

min_score.description: Similarity threshold from 0.5 to 1.0 (default 0.85). 1.0 = same first and last name (or business name) after normalization; lower values return weaker possible matches.

names.description: Names to screen (1 to 25), e.g. ["Jane Doe", {"name": "John Q. Public", "state": "TX", "dob": "1970-01-31"}, "Acme Home Health LLC"].

state.description: Optional state filter applied to every name that does not set its own.

type.description: Optional: "individual" for a person, "entity" for a business. Default: both.

name: screen_exclusions
